[[File:Donut.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A [[Hiromi]] eating a doughnut.]]
'''Doughnuts''', also known as '''donuts''', were circular cakes with a hole in the middle. They were often covered in different types of icing. They were a favorite food of [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltrons]]. They were also enjoyed by [[Hiromi]], who discovered them in the royal kitchens when they invaded [[Zeltros/Legends|Zeltros]].<ref name="m104">[[Star Wars (1977) 104|''Star Wars'' (1977) 104]]</ref>

[[Porcellus/Legends|Porcellus]], [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba's]] chef, brought [[vine-coffee]] and a doughnut to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Princess Leia]] while she was enslaved by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], but the coffee and doughnut were appropriated by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]].<ref name="chef">{{StoryCite|story=Taster's Choice: The Tale of Jabba's Chef|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref>

When [[Kyle Katarn]] [[Mission to Danuta|infiltrated]] the Imperial facility on [[Danuta]] to steal the plans to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], he shot an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] commando who was eating a doughnut.<ref name="df:ra">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref>

[[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] owned a doughnut shop called [[Dex's Donuts]] where he served such varieties as iced donuts with [[Iced donut with shredded Ishi Tib-cracked coconut|shredded Ishi Tib-cracked coconut]] or [[Iced donut with dark matter sprinkles|dark matter sprinkles]], [[Dianoga cream-filled donut]]s, [[Yowvetch custard-filled donut]]s, [[Muja fruit-filled donut]]s, and [[powdered Christophsian sugar donut]]s.<ref name="DAD">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref>
